name: M5.ConditionalCount.restricted_subset_domain
statement: ∀ (W : Finset ℕ) (d k : ℕ), (M5.ConditionalCount.restricted W d).powersetCard k = (W.powersetCard k).filter (fun U => ∀ s ∈ U, d ∣ s)
guidance: Extensionality and Finset.mem_powersetCard. Subset of W.filter means subset of W and every element satisfies divisibility. Return tactic lines only without leading by; keep exact target.
